info.name: FISCAi Yuki API Connector
info.description: Not an official Yuki or Visma product. A complementary, read-only collection aligned to the plugin's allow-list; the official reference is the Yuki API Webservices Documentation on Postman (https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/12207912/UVCBB51L). Intended for Belgian bookkeepers/accountants; based on Belgian accounting and VAT rules (MAR, Belgian VAT system). Use outside Belgium: verify the local rules yourself. Powered by FISCALCI Accounting & Tax (Askin Alci)

item.name: 00 Authentication
item.description: Run this first. The test script stores the session in the collection variable session_id.

request.description:
Authenticate with your own access key (environment variable, secret).

Official reference: https://api.yukiworks.be/ws/Accounting.asmx?op=Authenticate (verify current documentation).

exec: // Stores the session id in a collection variable. Never logs or prints it.

item.name: 99 DISABLED - requires explicit approval
item.description: Not used by default. The plugin itself keeps writing off unless YUKI_WRITE_ENABLED is set. Do not run these without explicit approval.

request.description:
DISABLED, requires explicit approval. Changes only the session context (current domain); needed by Archive and Contact calls with an accountant key.

Official reference: https://api.yukiworks.be/ws/Accounting.asmx?op=SetCurrentDomain (verify current documentation).

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <soap:Body>
    <ProcessJournal xmlns="http://www.theyukicompany.com/"><sessionID>{{session_id}}</sessionID><administrationID>{{administration_id}}</administrationID><xmlDoc><!-- [Voorbeeld] journal XML: see docs/BOEKINGSWORKFLOW.md --></xmlDoc></ProcessJournal>
  </soap:Body>
</soap:Envelope>

request.description:
DISABLED, requires explicit approval. WRITE call: books a journal entry. Do not run it unless you intend to book. Never for workflow documents (finish those with Afhandelen in Yuki).

Official reference: https://api.yukiworks.be/ws/Accounting.asmx?op=ProcessJournal (verify current documentation).
